description: Asset event type registry. Each entry pins the current payload schema version that producers MUST emit. See VERSIONING.md.

action_upserted.description: Emitted when a row in `actions` is created or modified. Same-tx with the actions write.

action_deleted.description: Emitted when an `actions` row is soft-deleted. Same-tx with the actions write.

asset_created.description: Emitted when an asset row is created. Same-tx with assets insert.

asset_updated.description: Emitted when mutable asset fields are updated. Same-tx with assets update.

asset_lifecycle_changed.description: Emitted when lifecycle/status fields change on an asset.

tag_upserted.description: Emitted when a tag is created or updated on an asset.

tag_deleted.description: Emitted when a tag is deleted from an asset.

algo_started.description: Emitted when an algorithm transitions to running.

algo_finished.description: Emitted when an algorithm run finishes with status ok.

algo_failed.description: Emitted when an algorithm run finishes with status failed.

algo_reset.description: Emitted when an algorithm state is reset to pending.

algo_unblocked.description: Emitted when a blocked algorithm becomes pending.

algo_run_applied.description: Emitted when a registered algo run is applied to an asset via finish.

eval_result_reported.description: Emitted after eval result persistence succeeds.

delivery_committed.description: Emitted when delivery commit writes complete for an asset.

mcap_file_created.description: Emitted when an MCAP file metadata row is created.

mcap_upload_finalized.description: Emitted when MCAP upload finalization updates ingest state.
